### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/objectql`, touching **18** documentable anchor(s).

**17** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3bd28e2b2ea81206dc9f5507de205b564bd97097`.

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `created_at (literal, 34 pages)`
- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **207** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **153** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **153**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **98** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **24** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3bd28e2b2ea81206dc9f5507de205b564bd97097` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `084b27869487861f3f0eafb801a7292c6bd6fca0` — the merge of head `4da90165cd7deebc159117dfb9c2b5b26e26a9a3` into base `3bd28e2b2ea81206dc9f5507de205b564bd97097`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 084b27869487861f3f0eafb801a7292c6bd6fca0 && git checkout 084b27869487861f3f0eafb801a7292c6bd6fca0
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 3bd28e2b2ea81206dc9f5507de205b564bd97097 4da90165cd7deebc159117dfb9c2b5b26e26a9a3 && git checkout -B drift-repro 3bd28e2b2ea81206dc9f5507de205b564bd97097 && git merge --no-ff 4da90165cd7deebc159117dfb9c2b5b26e26a9a3

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3bd28e2b2ea81206dc9f5507de205b564bd97097
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 3bd28e2b2ea81206dc9f5507de205b564bd97097` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f22f0e875f54c812b39af25c31ebfda8fd5a44b9`

Scope: PR #20174 (card #20148, `priority:p2`, class-closure, 5 pin rows). 8 files, +972/−29, all in the PR's own two commits (`3129311d33`, `d831680d7c`); the merge `f22f0e875f` brings `main` at `369bcbeda7` and no `main` commit in `49144fccc8..e2c4e125f9` touches any of the 8 paths (blobs `engine.ts` bc4f337220→4e1ebbf2a4, `having-filter.ts` 876293a1e9→ab6ba1df00, `protocol.ts` ba5fbccde6→a9a77c8f6d; `main`'s copies of all three are still the base blobs). Measured, not inferred: detached worktrees of head and base (`49144fccc8`) with the `rest` / `driver-sql` / `driver-memory` closures built (dist markers verified head 1/2/4, base 0/0/0), my own harness on a real `InMemoryDriver` and a real `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3 `:memory:`), schema-synced, populated (6 rows, c1/c2/c3) and empty, through `engine.aggregate` / `engine.find` and `POST /api/v1/data/:object/query` (JSON round-tripped), driver reads counted, engine `warn` captured: **3136 cells per tree; 2624 identical base→head, 512 moved — 460 per-aggregation cells, 52 `having` cells, 0 `where` twins, 0 `groupBy`.** Inputs: card + comments 5834285763 / 5852472098 / 5852943342 / 5852957006, #20122 / #20123 / #20127 / PR #20147, #20099 / PR #20117, #7534, #7929 / #8220, PR body, diff, check-runs. Dev's scratch not read.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Rows 1–4 refused at head, bar met.** Every refusal fires with `aggregate 0 / find 0 / count 0` driver reads, the same code/status/message on the empty and the populated table, grouped and ungrouped, both drivers, engine and REST (0 bar violations over all refused cells). Row 1 family (8 shapes incl. `$in` member, `$between` endpoint, implicit, held `$or`, `$not`, `'noon'` on `time`): base counted 0 / 1 / 6 / 0 / 6 / 6 / 0, head `INVALID_FILTER`/400 all 16 cells; twin `INVALID_FILTER`/400·0 reads on both drivers. `'last_30_days'`: engine `INVALID_FILTER`, REST `VALIDATION_FAILED` unchanged (= twin split). Row 2 family (8 shapes): base 0 (date/datetime 4, held `$or` 6), head `INVALID_FILTER` all 16; twin sql `INVALID_FILTER` (driver compiler, r1/0), memory a count (0 or 6). Row 3 family (6 shapes incl. dotted referent, undeclared `addDays` offset): base 0 / 6 / 6 / 6 / 3 / 0, head `INVALID_FILTER` all 16; twin same split as row 2. Row 4 family: REST `INVALID_FIELD`/400·0 reads (8 cells; `field: nope`, message names `'aggregations[1].filter'`), engine unchanged (a count, as ruled: engine keeps registry-less name tolerance on this position, REST is the gate — same as `where`); `{ nope: { $median: 1 } }` REST `INVALID_FIELD` (field gate first, as for `where`), engine `INVALID_FILTER`; `id` / `created_at` keys admitted (m1 / m6, = twin). Row 5 (in-process): `Date $gt` on `datetime` base m0 → head m4 = twin n4 on both drivers; all ten `datetime` shapes and UTC-midnight `Date` on `date` ($gt 1, $gte 3, $eq 2) now equal the twin. **Residual as disclosed:** `Date` with time-of-day on `date` ($gte 1 vs 3, $lt 5 vs 3, $eq 0 vs 2) and `Date` on `time` (0 vs 3) — open question 2 → A stands.
- **Valid per-aggregation filters keep their counts:** 16 controls (implicit 2, `$gt` 3, `$in` 2, `$or` 3, `$field` numeric pair 4, `addDays` date/date 5, offset column 3, datetime/datetime 2, `created_at` 6, `id` 6, good date 3, `{today}` 6, `{}` 6, `$ne null` 6, `$between` 4, cross-class `$field` without `addDays` held at 0) byte-identical base→head.
- **No collateral.** Every `where` twin (aggregate verb and `find`, engine and REST, both drivers, both populations, 76 shapes): 0 moved. 4 `groupBy` probes: 0 moved. Every `having` cell without a `Date` bound (#20123 key refusals ×6, #20127 pair refusals ×5, #20099 walker ×3, 8 controls, 5 ISO controls; both `applyHaving` doors): 0 moved. #20122's landed refusals (unknown op, bare `$field`, `$field` as `$in` member / `$exists` operand, `addDays 1.5`, type door) and #15661's text-operator door: messages byte-identical, still naming the fields.
- **`having` `Date` cells.** 52 moved on my set (13 `Date` shapes × 2 doors × 2 drivers, populated only; the dev's 36 = 9 shapes). Every `min(datetime)` cell moves to exactly the REST/ISO answer. Two `max(date)` shapes move **toward the `where` date rule and away from the ISO-instant text**: `midnight $gte on max(date)` [] → c2,c3 (ISO-instant keeps c2; bare-day `'2026-02-01'` keeps c2,c3) — the one the dev named — and `midnight $eq on max(date)` [] → c3 (ISO-instant keeps none; bare-day keeps c3) — **not named** in the PR body's "except" clause. No cell moves away from the `where` answer.
- **Pins discriminate.** At head: PR pins green (objectql 4 aggregate/having files 316 passed incl. #20147 / #20117 pins; protocol 13; rest 15). Reverse state (three files restored by blob to bc4f337220 / 876293a1e9 / ba5fbccde6, `#20148` marker counts 0/0/0, objectql + metadata-protocol force-rebuilt, dist markers 0/0): `engine-aggregate-filter.test.ts` **34 failed | 73 passed (107)**, `protocol.aggregation-filter-fields.test.ts` **7 | 6 (13)**, `aggregation-filter-where-doors.test.ts` **10 | 5 (15)** — exactly the dev's counts; the red set is the 14 reference rows, 8 temporal rows, 12 `Date` rows (incl. the `having` row); controls stayed green. Restored to HEAD blobs (4e1ebbf2a4 / ab6ba1df00 / a9a77c8f6d), clean status, dist rebuilt with markers present.
- **Disclosure.** Rows 2/3 wire message (439 chars at index 1, under the 500 bound): names `aggregations[1].filter`, the rule, and "the full diagnostic is in the server log"; contains none of the fixture's field names nor any `$op` (leak set empty on all 14 shapes). Engine logs exactly one `warn` per refusal carrying the full diagnostic. Referent set = declared fields + `id`/`created_at`/`updated_at` — verified equal to `resolveQueryFields`'s `known` set, so the changeset's "the set the REST field gate reads" is TRUE. Mixed posture (rows 2/3 withheld, #20122's refusals named) is exactly as the seat ruled (Q1 → A).
- **Code reading confirms the PR body's mechanics:** temporal door fourth (after text-operator door, before type door) inside the loop only; `assertAggregationFilterReferencesAreDeclared` runs after `assertNodeIsEvaluable` (walker first — pinned); `offsetPairViolation` is the pure extraction of `assertOffsetPairIsTemporal`'s three arms, `having`'s words unchanged; `instantsOf` lifts only when a `Date` is on one side and `utcInstantMs` reads both (a `time` value / junk → unchanged comparison); `protocol.ts` hunks inside `assertAggregationFieldsExist` only, filter keys judged only after the aggregated-field check passes, `saveMetaItem` untouched.
- **PR body sentences judged FALSE / stale at head:** (a) H4 "`check-adr-0087-registration` reports 2 declared-breaking changesets" — at `f22f0e875f` with `--base 49144fccc8` it reports **4** (main's `19856-*` and `20055-*` ride in via the merge; verdict unchanged, both of the PR's carry `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`); the "2" is the pre-merge `d831680d7c` reading. (b) H3 "except the midnight-`Date` on `max(date)` row" under-names the class: `$eq` midnight on `max(date)` also departs from the ISO-instant answer (see above). Every other numeric cell in §1, §3, §4 that my fixture can reproduce matched.
- **Changeset sentences judged FALSE:** `.changeset/20148-aggregation-filter-where-doors.md` — (1) "`having` shares this comparison, so a `Date` bound in `having` keeps the groups its ISO spelling keeps." FALSE for a `date`-class aggregated column: `{ last_placed: { $gte: Date('2026-02-01T00:00Z') } }` keeps c2,c3 while the ISO-instant spelling keeps c2; `$eq` keeps c3 while the ISO spelling keeps none (both drivers, both doors). True for `datetime` columns. The PR body's H3 knows the exception; the shipped sentence does not carry it. (2) "refused in the words `driver-sql` uses for the same comparison in a `where`" — the wire sentence is new prose in driver-sql's withholding *posture*; it is not driver-sql's text. Every other sentence in both changesets checked TRUE against code and cells.
- **Pending changesets:** `20127-having-adddays-temporal-pair.md` last sentence "A per-aggregation `filter` (`aggregations[i].filter`) is not judged by this rule…" is now FALSE at head (it is judged, via `offsetPairViolation` against the object's declared fields) — outside this claim's file surface, see ③. `20122-aggregation-filter-row-independent.md` "Not changed: … a `{ $field }` reference as the whole comparand of a scalar comparison (with or without a whole-day `addDays`)" reads stale relative to the release (now conditional on a declared referent and the class rule) though framed as that PR's own before/after — see ③. `20099-having-where-doors.md` "A `having` key that names no column still keeps no group rather than being refused" has been FALSE since PR #20147 (#20123), not this PR's doing — see ③. `20123-*` unaffected.
- **Scope.** `packages/spec`, `driver-sql`, `driver-memory`: 0 files touched by the PR's commits. `where` path untouched (engine hunks inside the per-aggregation loop only). Private helpers + `offsetPairViolation` refactor: all inside `having-filter.ts`; the one export change is the optional third parameter on `assertAggregationFilterIsEvaluable` (in surface) plus `export interface AggregationFilterDeclaration` — `having-filter.ts` is not re-exported by `packages/objectql/src/index.ts`, so no published-surface change; the PR body calls this type "private", which it is at package level but not at module level (nit). Accepted deviations per amendment 5852957006 stand.
- **Merge.** `git merge-tree --write-tree` of head onto current `origin/main` `e2c4e125f9`: clean, tree `a6eb4ce478` (none of the 8 paths is `merge=os-regen` routed; merge-base `369bcbeda7`).

### ② Semver level

- Declaration `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` is correct: requests that answered 200 with a zero count now answer 400 (rows 1–4) — an accept-set narrowing, BREAKING, and no spec/published-payload key changes. Row 5 / the `having` `Date` cells change the answer of already-accepted inputs toward the `where` answer — a correction, not a widening (the PR #20117 / #20147 bigint precedent), correctly carried under "Not refused, but answering differently".
- Level per package: `@objectstack/objectql` **minor** (BREAKING narrowing under the launch-window convention); `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` **minor** (same). Both changesets say `minor`, BREAKING banner, disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` — consistent with #20123 / #20127.
- `check-changeset-no-major --base 49144fccc8 --event <verbatim PR body>` at head: "✓ This diff introduces no `major` bump." · "✓ LEVEL AXIS: this PR declares clause-② `no (narrowing)`, and no package whose `packages/**/src/**` it moves is graded `patch`." · "direction arm: `narrowing` — a BREAKING change; during the launch window it ships `minor`" (exit 0).
- `check-adr-0087-registration --base 49144fccc8` at head: "✓ check-adr-0087-registration: 4 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition." — the PR's two `20148-*` changesets `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (no-migration-prescription)` (the other two, `19856-*` registered and `20055-*` not-required, are `main`'s). `check-empty-changeset`: ✓.
- CI at head (34 check runs, all completed): **31 success, 3 skipped** (`Build Docs`, `Console Pin Gate`, `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`), **0 failed**. All seven required contexts `success`: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Build Core`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Open question 1 (disclosure) → A: confirmed implemented as ruled; C stays the maintainer's (a withholding-posture relaxation, #7929 / #8220). Open question 2 (row-5 residual) → A: confirmed; the residual plus out-of-scope finding 1 (interpretable temporal STRING compared as text — reproduced: `{ placed_on: { $gte: '2026-02-01T00:00:00.000Z' } }` counts 1 vs twin 3; `{ opened_at: { $lte: '2026-02-01' } }` 2 vs 3; epoch-ms 0 vs 4; base = head) belong in the seat's follow-up card. Out-of-scope finding 2 reproduced (`InMemoryDriver` `where` `{ $field }` → 0 rows vs SqlDriver 4).
- **Pending-changeset drift, seat's call:** `20127-*`'s final sentence is FALSE at head; amending it is outside the claim's file surface (`.changeset/20148-*.md`). Either widen the surface by that one file for a one-clause amendment in the patch round, or accept the compiled CHANGELOG reading both entries. `20099-*`'s "still keeps no group" clause has been FALSE since PR #20147 — pre-existing. `20122-*`'s "Not changed … `{ $field }` reference" is stale in the release frame only.
- Position label `where.FIELD.OP` on rows 1 and the #15661 door: accepted deviation (needs a `path` parameter in `temporal-comparand-door.ts`, outside the claim) — carrier still 承接者:无.
- `param` is dropped from the REST envelope for row 4 (`err.param` set, wire carries `field` + `object` + the message naming `'aggregations[1].filter'`) — pre-existing envelope behaviour shared with `where`, not this PR's.

In the same edit, replace "refused in the words `driver-sql` uses for the same comparison in a `where`" with the accurate "refused in the withholding posture `driver-sql` applies to the same comparison in a `where`" (the sentence is new; the posture is borrowed).

Optional in the same push (PR body, not shipped prose): H4 "reports 2" → the at-head reading (4, two of them `main`'s); H3 "except" clause → name both `max(date)` midnight shapes (`$gte` and `$eq`).

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4da90165cd7deebc159117dfb9c2b5b26e26a9a3`

Scope: delta review of PR #20174 (card #20148) after FAIL 5853139988 at `f22f0e875f`, under seat amendment 2 (5853144038: file surface widened by two pending changesets for one-clause DELIBERATE CORRECTIONS). **This record carries forward my measured code judgments from the review of `f22f0e875f` on the identical blobs**: `git diff-tree -r f22f0e875f 4da90165cd` lists exactly three paths, all under `.changeset/`; every non-changeset file is blob-identical (`engine.ts` 4e1ebbf2a4, `having-filter.ts` ab6ba1df00, `protocol.ts` a9a77c8f6d, `engine-aggregate-filter.test.ts` f9700d89a4, `protocol.aggregation-filter-fields.test.ts` 13a6e9a0ef, `aggregation-filter-where-doors.test.ts` e98e39a758, `20148-aggregation-filter-keys-rest.md` 4d50a11e34). `git diff --numstat f22f0e875f 4da90165cd` is exactly `1 1 .changeset/20099-having-where-doors.md`, `1 1 .changeset/20127-having-adddays-temporal-pair.md`, `2 2 .changeset/20148-aggregation-filter-where-doors.md` — the dev's claim holds; in each foreign file the single changed line is the paragraph named below and every other line is byte-identical (unified diff shows one `-`/`+` pair per file). The branch did not re-merge `main`: merge-base with `origin/main` is still `369bcbeda7`; `origin/main` is now `455dcc060d` (7 commits ahead), and none of those 7 commits touches any of the PR's 10 paths (`git diff --name-only 369bcbeda7 origin/main -- <the 10 paths>` = empty). A worktree at `4da90165cd` was built (closure cache-hit; dist markers 1/1) and my harness re-run: **3136 cells, 3136 identical to the `f22f0e875f` run, 0 differ** — the code judgments transfer without exception.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Rewritten sentences, read literally at this head against code and cells:**
  - `20148-aggregation-filter-where-doors.md`, the `Date` bullet: "`having` shares this comparison, so a `Date` bound in `having` keeps the groups its ISO spelling keeps on a `datetime` column" — **TRUE** (all 10 `min(datetime)` shapes equal the REST/ISO cell on both doors, both drivers). "on a `date`-class column (`min` / `max` of a `date` field) a UTC-midnight `Date` follows the calendar-day reading a `where` gives (`{ $gte: new Date('2026-02-01') }` keeps the group whose max is `2026-02-01`, and so does `$eq`), which the ISO-instant text, compared as text, did not" — **TRUE** on my cells: `$gte` midnight `Date` on `max(placed_on)` keeps c2,c3 (c3's max is `2026-02-01`), `$eq` keeps c3; the ISO-instant text keeps c2 / none; the bare-day `where` reading keeps c2,c3 / c3 — and the `where` twin on the raw column counts 3 for the midnight `$gte`. `min` is asserted by symmetry only (I measured `max`); scoped-true.
  - `20148-*`, the posture sentence: "refused in the withholding posture `driver-sql` applies to the same comparison in a `where`: the message names the aggregation that carries the reference (`aggregations[1].filter`) and the rule, and withholds the fields, the operator and the specific reason" — **TRUE** (wire message names `aggregations[1].filter`, 439 chars, leak set empty for all 14 row-2/3 shapes; one `warn` per refusal carries the diagnostic).
  - `20127-having-adddays-temporal-pair.md`, last sentence: "A per-aggregation `filter` (`aggregations[i].filter`) is not judged by this change: it reads the object's raw columns, and this change classifies only the aggregated row's. Since #20148 it is judged by the same class rule, against the object's declared fields." — **TRUE**. The rule is one function, `offsetPairViolation`, called by `having` through `assertOffsetPairIsTemporal` and by the per-aggregation walk `assertAggregationFilterReferencesAreDeclared`, with classes from `declaredFieldClass(fields, name)` over declared fields + `id`/`created_at`/`updated_at`. Measured at this head: `addDays` numeric pair, date→numeric, date/datetime, text/date, time pair, text or date offset column: `INVALID_FILTER`/400·0 reads on all 16 cells each. Words differ by position, and the sentence does not claim otherwise: `having` names the columns; the per-aggregation position withholds them on the wire and puts the same #20127 sentence in the `warn` line.
  - `20099-having-where-doors.md`, "Not changed" paragraph: "A `having` key that names no column is not judged by this change; since #20123 it is refused (`INVALID_FILTER` / 400) rather than keeping no group." — **TRUE**: `{ totl: { $gt: 100 } }`, `$ne`, under `$not`, behind a held `$or`, a source column, a dotted key: `INVALID_FILTER`/400 with 0 driver reads on all 16 cells per shape (native and fallback `applyHaving` doors × `InMemoryDriver`/`SqlDriver` × empty/populated × engine/REST). "since #20123" names the card; the code landed in PR #20147 — a reference, not a falsity.
- **PR body, changed sections, sentence by sentence (final body, 19775 bytes):** header ("prose-only patch round … every code and test blob is unchanged" + the three blob ids) TRUE; commit-table row for `4da90165cd` TRUE; H3 "except the two UTC-midnight-`Date` shapes on `max(date)` … `$gte` keeps `c2, c3` where the ISO-instant spelling keeps `c2`, and `$eq` keeps `c3` where the ISO-instant spelling keeps none" TRUE; H4 "reports 4 … this PR's two `20148-*`, and `main`'s `19856-*` (registered) and `20055-*` (not-required) … Against `origin/main` it reports this PR's two" TRUE; "Patch round" section TRUE (three files, numstat, the two wording sentences, gate lines); "DELIBERATE CORRECTION" section — "`1 1`, every other line byte-identical" TRUE, each Before/After quotation matches the `-`/`+` lines byte for byte; Deviations — "module-level helpers … `AggregationFilterDeclaration` … package-private" TRUE. No FALSE sentence remains in the body or in the three changesets.
- **DELIBERATE CORRECTION confirmation (landing-operations: the record names each changed note and judges each rewritten sentence).** Note `.changeset/20099-having-where-doors.md`: one clause rewritten, judged TRUE above; the pre-change clause was FALSE since PR #20147.
